evals.description: Adapt generated SPC C output into an MPU app using a reference view style.
evals.prompt: Adapt doc/mcud-spc_out/mcud/c into app/mcud, following common/view/spc_hq_fota_app style.
evals.expected_output: Creates common/view/spc_mcud, copies generated app/conn/srv runtime files, adds wrapper lifecycle files, updates CMake, and wires init/done in main.c.
criteria: Does not copy generated main_client.c or main_server.c
Creates wrapper init/done/run-once APIs
Updates CMake include and source directories
Places lifecycle calls in main.c at sensible dependency points

evals.description: Bridge generated SPC service handlers to xrpc process wrapper APIs.
evals.prompt: Generated mcud_srv.c contains TODO handlers. Forward SPC requests to XrpcProcess* APIs in business/xrpc/inc/xrpc_process_define.h.
evals.expected_output: Each SPC handler reads request parameters, fills the matching TXrpcProcess* input struct, calls XrpcProcess*, writes output fields on success, and returns the Int32 result.
criteria: Uses existing XrpcProcess* wrappers instead of ad hoc encoding
Initializes input and output structs
Avoids uninitialized response fields
Handles string length copying safely

evals.description: Move service RunOnce maintenance into an SFC task thread.
evals.prompt: SpcMcudSrvRunOnce() must run in a separate thread using mpu/sdk/include/sfc/sfc_task.h.
evals.expected_output: Adds sfc/sfc_task.h, creates a TSfTask, runs SpcMcudSrvRunOnce in OnExecute with sleep, starts it in init, and stops/waits in done. Removes main-loop RunOnce call.
criteria: Uses TSfTaskCreate, TSfTaskResume, TSfTaskStart
Uses TSfTaskTerminated in the task loop
Stops and waits for the task before closing SPC
Removes direct main-loop SpcMcudSrvRunOnce call

evals.description: Create a sibling SPC client test project from generated client code.
evals.prompt: Create spc_mcud_clt_test beside app/mcud, following app/spc_hq_fota_app_clt_test style.
evals.expected_output: Creates app/spc_mcud_clt_test with build scripts, CMake target, test framework, generated mcud_client/conn files, a SpanCall lifecycle test entry, and interactive command handlers for all generated client APIs.
criteria: Places generated client and conn files under common/spc_mcud/c
Does not compile generated main_client.c
Creates one project-specific test main entry
Adds command handlers for connection smoke tests and generated client methods
Links the same SDK libraries used by the reference client test project

evals.prompt: Adapt missing generated directory doc/not-exist-spc_out/foo/c into an MPU project.
criteria: Checks the generated directory before editing
Does not create partial adapter files
Asks for the correct generated path

evals.description: Build script cannot access Docker daemon.
evals.prompt: Use az_build_linux.bat to verify build, but Docker pipe access is denied.
criteria: Preserves the raw Docker permission error
Does not replace the user-provided script with unrelated commands
Asks for authorization or user-side rerun of the same script

evals.description: Generated SPC methods do not map cleanly to existing business APIs.
evals.prompt: Bridge generated SPC server handlers, but some generated method names have no clear XrpcProcess* equivalent.
criteria: Implements only mappings confirmed by local headers or existing code
Does not invent wire semantics for ambiguous methods
Leaves explicit TODOs or reports the unmatched methods
Still initializes all response variables and returns a defined error for unmapped handlers
